title: P09.9: два совместимых тестовых стека; OWNER-WAIT

sections.title: Предложение и точные версии
sections.text:
Рекомендуемый вариант A: отдельные test-harness manifests/locks для Laravel12 и Laravel13. Root development stack остаётся Pest5.2.1/PHPUnit13.3.4. Единственное снижение закреплённых версий разрешается явно владельцем только в Laravel12 harness.

| Laravel | Framework | Testbench | Pest | PHPUnit | Process |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|12|12.69.3|10.12.0|4.7.8|12.5.33|7.4.19|
|13|13.35.0|11.3.0|5.2.1|13.3.4|8.1.7|

Infection0.35.6, abstract adapter0.5.1, include interceptor1.0.0 и bounded adapter0.1.0 общие. Каждый Laravel lock проверен на обоих PHP. Матрица и пороги MSI95/90/75 сохранены. Цена: два воспроизводимых lock и проверка обоих семейств raw Pest reports. Вариант B: сохранить один закреплённый Pest5 стек; P09.9 остаётся blocked до upstream совместимости. Общий downgrade root стека до Pest4 не рекомендуется: затрагивает проверенный Laravel13 root без необходимости. Plain PHPUnit, ослабление порогов и сужение матрицы не являются вариантами этого предложения.

sections.title: Проверенные источники, solves и границы доказательства
sections.text:
Source a83248a0; previous artifacts/P09.9-execution/completion.md and matrix/receipt.json remain incompatible. Primary tagged composer manifests were retrieved via HTTPS and are hash-bound in artifacts/P09.9-stack-proposal/{sources,spike/sources}/index.json. Pest4.7.8 requires Process ^7.4.13|^8.1.0 and exactly PHPUnit12.5.33 via require/conflict; Laravel12.69.3 requires Process ^7.2.0; Infection0.35.6 permits ^7.4. Process7.4.19 is their verified intersection. Pest5.2.1 requires Process ^8.1.7 and exactly PHPUnit13.3.4; Laravel13.35.0 and Testbench11.3.0 permit that version. Testbench10.12.0 selects core10.15.0; Testbench11.3.0 selects core11.5.0. Composer selects ParaTest7.20.0 for Pest4 and 7.25.0 for Pest5.

Isolated spike graph: four real PHP8.4.26/8.5.11 × Laravel12/13 update --no-install --no-plugins --no-scripts solves exit0; check-platform-reqs --lock and audit --locked exit0. Each Laravel-specific PHP8.4 lock also installs with --dry-run and passes platform verification on PHP8.5; separate PHP8.5 solves pass too. Full root projections: same four solves/platform/audits and cross-PHP lock replay exit0 after adding the existing missing bcmath extension to the temporary PHP8.5 invocation only. Initial missing-extension/restart failures are retained, not concealed. Download/extraction of the matching php8.5-bcmath deb changed no system packages/configuration; hashes are in bcmath-package.json. COMPOSER_ALLOW_XDEBUG=1 prevents Composer from restarting without the temporary -d extension. No platform spoof/ignore flag, vendor patch or security-ignore policy was used.

These are solve/platform/audit/dry-run proofs, not installation or real Pest4 mutation execution. Plugin activation, coverage/JUnit format, actual Pest4 tests and mutant classification remain mandatory acceptance after approval. No eight-row runtime GREEN, MSI measurement, hosted CI or release readiness is claimed. Root inputs are hash-invariant in protected-inputs.json; product code/dependencies unchanged.

sections.title: Точная поправка к D120 и P09.9, ещё не применена
sections.text:
Уточнение P09.9, только после принятия PLAN3.D131 владельцем: поддерживаемая матрица PHP 8.4–8.5 × Laravel 12–13 × SQLite/PostgreSQL сохраняется полностью. Разрешены два repository-only тестовых стека с отдельными composer.json/composer.lock: Laravel12 12.69.3 + Testbench10.12.0 + Pest4.7.8 + PHPUnit12.5.33 + symfony/process7.4.19; Laravel13 13.35.0 + Testbench11.3.0 + Pest5.2.1 + PHPUnit13.3.4 + symfony/process8.1.7. Infection0.35.6, abstract-testframework-adapter0.5.1, include-interceptor1.0.0 и bounded Pest CLI adapter0.1.0 остаются тем же engine/route. Это единственное явное исключение из прежнего запрета снижения Pest/PHPUnit: только Laravel12 harness, не root development stack и не публичные package manifests. Root Pest5.2.1/PHPUnit13.3.4 и все остальные locked package records сохраняются; root lock допускает лишь изменение require metadata локального adapter, расширенного до точных альтернатив 4.7.8||5.2.1 и 12.5.33||13.3.4. Два harness lock генерируются на PHP8.4 и проверяются install/check-platform-reqs на обоих реальных интерпретаторах; во время матрицы выполняется только install, не update. Не использовать replace/provide aliases, vendor patches, ignore-platform-reqs, отключение security audit или фиксированные патчи вместо Infection. Одно дерево исходников/тестов и одинаковые требования raw Pest/coverage XML/JUnit/process evidence обязательны во всех восьми строках. MSI security95/messaging90/other75, uncovered/timeout/error semantics и все остальные положения D120 не изменяются. D125 repository-only имеет приоритет. Разрешение на изменение контрактов и стеков не запускает P09.5 или release-работы.

Machine patch: artifacts/P09.9-stack-proposal/approved-plan-edits.json. Полный proposed item: artifacts/P09.9-stack-proposal/P09.9-contract.json. D120 и текущие acceptance/status/result P09.9 остаются неизменными до согласования. PLAN3.D131 — открытый вопрос владельцу; принятие варианта A разрешает эту точную поправку, не исполнение других items.

sections.title: Контракт последующего исполнения только P09.9
sections.text:
Admission: owner accepts option A of D131; apply artifacts/P09.9-stack-proposal/approved-plan-edits.json using the currently installed Task plan.py. Its three patches change only D120, the P09.9 paragraph of the old mutation runbook, and P09.9 contract. They do not change lifecycle status/results. Verify current D120/P09.9 against before-* carriers before applying; rebase a conflicting later amendment instead of overwriting it. Archive the previous blocked context/result (already captured in before-P09.9.json and P09.9-execution), then plan.py reopen PLAN3 P09.9 --reason quoting owner approval. Do not reset via raw JSON status writes. Check current prerequisites. Run only $ task:plan-run 2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL P09.9; stop at that item. Approval of this design does not authorize P09.5 or a release successor.

Materialize scripts/quality/infection-stacks/laravel{12,13}/composer.{json,lock} from candidate-stacks. These are sandbox templates: copy each to the cell root, along with scripts/quality/infection-pest-adapter, the current tenancy fragment and the same generated controls/probe. Their relative adapter path is intentionally resolved in the sandbox; do not run install in the template directory or link a cell vendor into root. No shared vendor, Composer aliases/replaces or dual framework autoloading. Testbench is included as an exact stack dependency; do not count its presence as a full Testbench/package suite run. Adapt only the local adapter manifest require to the hypothetical-adapter-composer.json exact Pest/PHPUnit alternatives, retain code behavior and version0.1.0; hash-bound source detects changes. Copy a locked adapter record into root via a targeted Composer lock update only after approval, preserving every other complete locked package record and content-hash. Do not update root Pest/PHPUnit/Laravel, root composer.json or package manifests. Locks captured here bind the hypothetical manifest; if content/ref changes during implementation, regenerate only that finite path record transparently and repeat the four stack install/platform/audit checks, not unrelated dependency updates.

Policy/receipt v2: common engine versions + explicit Laravel12/Laravel13 stack maps; select exclusively by Laravel major, never whichever engine solves first. Pin Framework/Testbench/Pest/PHPUnit/Process and the transitive versions from each lock. prepare_cell copies manifest+lock, performs install --no-scripts --no-progress with only Pest and Infection extension plugins allowed; refuses update/no-lock fallback. --check-stacks materializes isolated dirs, validates strict manifests and lock consistency, installs and runs check-platform-reqs/audit on both actual PHP versions, and verifies root complete package-record invariance (only exact adapter require metadata may differ). Receipt binds stack id, original template manifest/lock digests, installed lock, all runtime versions, source/tests/controls/tools hashes, PHP binary/extensions, plugin/adapter trace, flags and process exits. Missing or mixed-stack cells, changed locks, old v1 receipts and stale/empty evidence fail.

Fresh runtime acceptance: PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel12/13 × sqlite/pgsql = eight rows. Keep the existing 13 cases: nine actual tenancy DatabaseValue cases, one real Laravel/PDO temporary-table probe and three controls, with 25 assertions. Use PCOV or Xdebug actually available; raw coverage XML/JUnit, not transformed class names. Infection0.35.6 --with-uncovered --with-timeouts --threads=1 --log-verbosity=all --debug uses the same bounded Pest CLI adapter. Each row must reproduce four real killed package mutants plus one each escaped, uncovered, timeout and controlled exit137 error; retain real stdout/stderr/exits and raw reports. Recognized generated compatibility timeout/error controls must be separately asserted and never counted as test kills; an unexpected discovery/bootstrap/PDO/coverage/OOM error is BLOCKED. Preserve strict warning/risky/empty-suite behavior. Any actual cross-Pest format difference needs version-specific validation from raw evidence, not relaxed assertions or normalization that fabricates success.

PG runs serial after devops:db-test-preflight: Docker/readiness, actual *_test database and migration-state observation. Only connection-local temporary probe tables; no migrations/reset of application DB. Run current V1–V4 plus V5–V7 in P09.9-contract.json; V6 is an owned new option, not an existing executable feature. New negatives cover wrong Laravel engine, same lock reused across Laravel majors, wrong manifest hash, absent/mismatched lock, update fallback, stale v1/partial rows and root record drift. Keep current 19 receipt negatives. Budgets 2h + at most 2h fallback repair; block with exact evidence at budget/failure. Archive new results separately (P09.9-execution-after-D131) and never rewrite old incompatible proof. Self-check against these invariants; no public source change or broad test rewrite.

Unchanged MSI policy: security95/messaging90/other75 per behavioral package-fragment; full source, uncovered denominator members, timeouts not kills, infrastructure errors block, syntax/compile invalid exclusions only with exact reproduction, equivalent exclusions exact/hash-bound with existing <=5% ceilings. P09.9 deliberately surviving controls are compatibility diagnostics only. P09.5 remains unexecuted; D125 excludes release qualification, RC/tags/publish and remote writes.
